quiz_title: Web Design - Quiz 1: HTML Core & Formatting

questions.q: Which tag defines the title of a web page displayed in the browser tab?
questions.exp: The <title> tag inside the <head> section sets the title that appears in the browser's title bar or tab!

questions.q: How many sizes of headings are available in HTML?
questions.exp: HTML has 6 standard heading tags from <h1> (largest) to <h6> (smallest).

questions.q: What is the correct way to add a line break in HTML?
questions.exp: The <br> tag creates a line break, pushing content to a new line without adding space like a paragraph.

questions.q: Which attribute specifies the source path of an image?
questions.exp: The 'src' (source) attribute contains the URL or file path of the image you want to embed.

questions.q: Which target value opens a hyperlink in a brand new tab?
questions.exp: Using target="_blank" tells the browser to open the link in a fresh, new tab!
